name: pipcast
description: KLWD, a local TV news channel for your Claude Code sessions: a window in the corner of your screen that airs BREAKING NEWS when a session needs you or finishes, and a report every hour on the hour

autoTuneIn.title: Tune in every new session
autoTuneIn.description: Each new session in the Claude desktop app tunes in to KLWD as it opens, with no TUNE IN to press. TUNE OUT still takes a session off the air.

transparentWindow.title: Transparent window
transparentWindow.description: The KLWD window fades to 40% while the pointer is elsewhere, so what is under it shows through, and turns solid again while the pointer is on it.
